message: is `<a>` in the SVG namespace to Angular, which draws it in the browser, and `<a>` in HTML
$reason: The reference's widget with its trigger alone, a link inside an SVG `<desc>`. Angular draws it in the namespace of the `<desc>`, an SVG link; the `<desc>` is an HTML integration point to the browser's HTML parser, which reads the link in it as HTML after SSR, and hydration keeps that one (measured on 2026-10-19: Angular 22.2's `renderApplication` and `provideClientHydration`, Chromium 153, Firefox 155, WebKit 26.6). Read as either, it passed as the carrier.
